reviewType: Independent peer review requested by parent after Americas pass; no main-array edit
qualification: Conditional, explicit processing/scope inference for actual steam-manufactured plain sencha; not a tea-specific ruling.
reasons: The current DBS page expressly addresses private senders/recipients and postal parcels. The plant-food subsections therefore are not confined to passenger baggage.

It expressly waives both import permit and phytosanitary certificate for plant food that underwent cooking; canned food is an example, not a mandatory package form. Industrial, commercial or other cooking is covered.
Actual steam manufacture of sencha reasonably supplies the cooking/thermal-process condition; mere drying or raw/herbal leaves should not be included by this inference.
Camellia is absent from the enumerated prohibited cooked species. The animal-food 10 kg limit is not a plant-food limit.

The currently maintained page cites Order324CM of16March2026, rather than the superseded740CM. Full Annex5 remains inaccessible and was not read; this is reliance on the current authority’s own operative guidance.
The page states it is a non-exhaustive summary. Preserve that source limitation and normal declaration/inspection duties.
